approved_scope.title: The workflow-v2 baseline history probe reads the baseline path literally
approved_scope.description: The workflow-v2 baseline history probe reads the baseline path literally
approved_scope.no_spec_change_rationale: A baseline that was never committed is absent, not deleted; the reachable-history probe passed the baseline path as a plain pathspec, so a project directory named like pathspec magic read as an exclude and reported the baseline deleted. The module's other history queries are literal top-level pathspecs (#851, #990) (#1074)
acceptance_criteria: in a project directory named :(exclude)app with no committed baseline, the reachable-history probe answers false and reading the baseline gives none instead of reporting it deleted
